baselines.consequence: Integration CANNOT use git merge/cherry-pick/rebase. It must be content- and responsibility-aware.

evidence: ai-native/v1 first commit is 251f822 'Sync current project snapshot'
planning/ai-native-v1/AI-native实施总计划.md declares the same base commit
AI_NATIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_BASE.reason: master and ai-native/v1 share no ancestry; 251f822 is the Native lineage's own snapshot point, not a common ancestor. The two lineages are separate imports of the same project.
AI_NATIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_BASE.usage: Only to determine the INTENDED Native delta.

contentRelationship.method: git ls-tree blob comparison of the two trees (no ancestry required)
contentRelationship.keyFinding: Every file on production master also exists on ai-native/v1, and 1173 of 1215 (96.5%) are byte-identical. master is a strict content subset of ai-native/v1. The integration delta is therefore small and bounded: 316 additions plus 42 modified files.

A_NATIVE_NEW_FILE.note: planning count includes one filename whose git ls-tree output is quoted (CJK), so 229 + 11 quoted = 240.

B_SHARED_FILE_NATIVE_MODIFICATION.note: All differing files are 'M' (modified) or 'A' (added) relative to master; there are no master-only files to lose.

C_PRODUCTION_NEWER_OR_DIVERGENT.note: Modified files whose master version contains at least one non-empty line that does NOT appear in the native version. These are the only files that can lose production content.

E_TEST_ONLY.conflictRisk: MEDIUM — some native tests encode the native lineage's expectations and may need adaptation to the production base

G_SHARED_BUSINESS_INFRASTRUCTURE.integrationAction: NEVER_REPLACE_WHOLESALE — merge Native responsibility into the CURRENT production implementation

conflictAnalysis.method: For each of the 42 modified files, compute the set of non-empty trimmed lines present in the master version but absent from the native version.
conflictAnalysis.cleanAdoptionCandidates: 22 files — master's content is a strict line-subset of the native version, so adopting the native file loses nothing.

route mounting; both lineages add routes

conflictAnalysis.notYetReviewed: The remaining files in the 20 (not enumerated above) still need per-file review; the list above is ordered by production-only line count and covers the highest-risk runtime files.
conflictAnalysis.unresolvedSharedConflicts: NOT_YET_RESOLVED — implementation phase has not started

does master's highest migration version exceed 87?

packageAudit.note: package-lock.json is among the 1173 identical files, so dependencies are unchanged between lineages. Only package.json scripts/metadata need merging.

routeAudit.PRODUCTION_ROUTES_LOST_EXPECTED: NONE — master has zero files of its own, so no route file disappears
